description: This file defines the HeaderFooterDrawing class, which extends the Drawing class, within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides a method to generate a hash code based on various properties of header/footer images in a spreadsheet worksheet.

classes.name: HeaderFooterDrawing
classes.description: Class representing a drawing used in the header or footer of a worksheet, extending the base Drawing class.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a MD5 hash code based on the current properties of the drawing, ensuring uniqueness for change detection.
